text:
1. Informed consent requirements now permeate many activities from school field trips to serious medical procedures. Every athlete should be made fully aware of the risks involved in the activity and formally (in writing) agree to undertake those risks.
2. Consent is a term used for people of legal age who are able to sign a legally binding contract. Assent refers to the agreement of the underage participant to take part in the activities and signifies that the underage participant understands the risks involved. Underage athletes will also require the consent of their parent or legal guardian.
